answer.reason: Several verses state events at Megiddo: Ahaziah died there, Josiah was slain there, and Solomon built it.

clauses.english: was where King Josiah was slain by Pharaoh Necho
clauses.quote: he slew him at Megiddo, when he had seen him.

clauses.english: was where King Ahaziah of Judah fled from Jehu and died
clauses.quote: he fled to Megiddo, and died there.

clauses.english: was built up by King Solomon
clauses.quote: to build the house of the LORD, and his own house, and Millo, and the wall of Jerusalem, and Hazor, and Megiddo, and Gezer.

doubts: JDG 5:19 (battle by the waters of Megiddo) was left out as a lesser event; ZEC 12:11 is a comparison, not an event.
1KI 9:15 says Solomon raised a levy to build Megiddo; the clause renders this as building.
